from common import *


def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
    from publish_single_v2 import selected_path

    assert not any(j['status'] == 'running' for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'])
    assert read(BASE / 'docs/final-numerical-verification.json')['status'] == 'complete'
    summary = read(BASE / 'docs/study-summary.json')
    targets = [v for v in VARIANTS if any(x['ensemble_below_all_seeds'] for x in summary['seed_diagnostics'][v]['ensemble_vs_components'].values())]
    inputs = read(BASE / 'docs/evaluation-inputs.json')
    check(inputs['cache'])
    saved = pd.read_pickle(inputs['cache']['path'])
    output = {'at': time.time(), 'trigger': 'Predeclared ensemble-below-all-components diagnostic', 'new_fits': 0, 'weight_or_seed_changes': False, 'targets': {}}
    for variant in targets:
        metric_path = selected_path(variant)
        metric = read(metric_path)
        proof_path = ROOT / metric['label_grading']['prediction_proof']['path']
        check(metric['label_grading']['prediction_proof'])
        proof = read(proof_path)
        preds = {}
        for c in proof['components']:
            check(c['prediction'])
            preds[str(c['seed'])] = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / c['prediction']['path']).iloc[:, 0]
        assert list(preds) == [str(s) for s in SEEDS]
        check(proof['ensemble'])
        ensemble = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / proof['ensemble']['path']).iloc[:, 0]
        rebuilt = blend_score_series(list(preds.values()))
        assert ensemble.index.equals(rebuilt.index) and np.array_equal(ensemble.to_numpy(), rebuilt.to_numpy())
        preds['ensemble'] = ensemble
        panels, recomputed = {}, {}
        heads = read(ROOT / metric['diagnostic_heads']['path'])
        check(metric['diagnostic_heads'])
        for name, pred in preds.items():
            panel = ev.daily_head_panel(pred, saved['labels'][5], [3], min_count=20, tradable=saved['tradable'])[3]
            stat = ev.summarize_head_series(panel['excess'], 5, sets=panel['sets'], k=3, port=panel['port'], bench=panel['bench'])
            reference = metric['pools']['all']['ensemble' if name == 'ensemble' else 'seeds']
            if name != 'ensemble':
                reference = reference[name]
            ref = reference['head']['3']['5']
            for key in ['net_ann', 'net_ann_vol', 'net_sharpe', 'ann', 'ann_cost', 'turnover']:
                assert abs(stat[key] - ref[key]) < 1e-12, (variant, name, key)
            original_heads = heads['ensemble']['3'] if name == 'ensemble' else heads['seeds'][name]['3']
            assert {str(day.date()): sorted(values) for day, values in panel['sets'].items()} == original_heads
            panels[name], recomputed[name] = panel, stat
        ens = panels['ensemble']
        label = saved['labels'][5]
        comparisons = {}
        for seed in map(str, SEEDS):
            component = panels[seed]
            assert ens['port'].index.equals(component['port'].index)
            delta = ens['port'] - component['port']
            replacements = []
            for day, names in ens['sets'].items():
                old = component['sets'][day]
                labels = label.xs(day, level='datetime')
                replacements.append((sum(float(labels.loc[x]) for x in names - old) - sum(float(labels.loc[x]) for x in old - names)) / 3)
            assert np.allclose(delta.to_numpy(), replacements, rtol=0, atol=1e-15)
            gross = float(delta.mean() * ev.TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR / 5)
            cost = recomputed['ensemble']['ann_cost'] - recomputed[seed]['ann_cost']
            net = recomputed['ensemble']['net_ann'] - recomputed[seed]['net_ann']
            assert abs(gross - cost - net) < 1e-12
            contributions = {str(y): float(part.sum() / len(delta) * ev.TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR / 5) for y, part in delta.groupby(delta.index.year)}
            assert abs(sum(contributions.values()) - gross) < 1e-12
            comparisons[seed] = {'mean_top3_overlap': float(np.mean([len(names & component['sets'][day]) / 3 for day, names in ens['sets'].items()])), 'days_identical_top3': sum(names == component['sets'][day] for day, names in ens['sets'].items()), 'days_ensemble_gross_above_seed': int((delta > 0).sum()), 'gross_ann_difference': gross, 'ann_cost_difference': cost, 'net_ann_difference': net, 'year_contribution_to_full_window_gross_ann_difference': contributions}
        absent_from_seed_heads = sum(len(names - set().union(*(panels[str(seed)]['sets'][day] for seed in SEEDS))) for day, names in ens['sets'].items())
        output['targets'][variant] = {'official_metrics_recomputed': recomputed, 'comparison_to_each_seed': comparisons, 'ensemble_picks_absent_from_all_seed_top3': absent_from_seed_heads, 'total_ensemble_picks': 3 * len(ens['sets']), 'ensemble_rebuilt_exactly': True, 'selected_heads_reproduced_exactly': True, 'selection_replacement_return_identity_passed': True, 'sources': {'metric': fingerprint(metric_path), 'predictions': fingerprint(proof_path), 'heads': metric['diagnostic_heads'], 'evaluation_inputs': inputs['cache']}}
    output['interpretation_scope'] = 'Checks aggregation, canonical metrics and exact head-replacement accounting. Score averaging followed by top3 is nonlinear; this does not establish a unique economic cause or justify removing seeds, changing weights, extending training or selecting on this diagnostic.'
    write(BASE / 'docs/ensemble-shortfall-diagnostic.json', output)
    print(json.dumps({'targets': list(output['targets']), 'all_exact_checks_passed': True, 'new_fits': 0}), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
